rationale: PyDESeq2 Wald with in-model median-of-ratios size factors, explicit reference level and contrast direction, apeglm-style shrinkage with a stated fallback, independent filtering and BH at 0.05 fits the 6v6 unpaired single-batch Python-only design exactly, and the shallow sample_01 is kept under an explicit inspect-and-report policy with a sensitivity re-run as the robustness check. QC is complete (library sizes, detected genes, blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, condition coloring) and the ~10 counts in >=6 samples filter is minimal and tied to the smallest group. Enrichment uses gseapy prerank on the full Wald-statistic-ranked list with Hallmark 2026.1 named, a 15-500 window and the tested-gene universe, but the fixed seed is only mentioned as something to record in the report rather than set in the enrichment step, and the added Reactome/WikiPathways/GO collections exceed the hallmark question asked; the plan also loosely calls gseapy prerank 'fgsea'. The report specification covers method, versions, design, thresholds, gene counts and the design caveats thoroughly.
